articles.summary: As regulatory bodies worldwide tighten their requirements, robust Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance becomes even more significant for businesses. The consequences of failing to implement effective KYC measures include hefty fines and severe reputational damage. This not only protects businesses but also customers.
articles.title: The Importance of KYC Compliance for Businesses

articles.summary: Optical Character Recognition technology has become essential for modern payment systems, automating tasks like scanning credit cards and processing invoices. Here’s how OCR works, its role in payments, and the key benefits it offers to businesses.
articles.title: What is OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and How Does it Work in Payments?
